lesson.title: What happens first?
lesson.scenario: Tomorrow evening, Fattoush and Knafeh agree to tea at six and a meal afterwards. In practice, a new instruction may reverse the order: preserve the order requested in that exchange.

steps.instruction: Propose tea first and making rice and salad afterwards.

answers.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
answers.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
answers.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.
answers.rationale: Tea precedes the meal, as requested.

answers.arabic: نعمل رز وسلطة وبعدين نشرب شاي.
answers.arabizi: Niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa w-baʿdēn nishrab shāy.
answers.meaning: We’ll make rice and salad and then drink tea.
answers.rationale: Both activities fit, but their order is reversed.

answers.meaning: We’ll visit your family and then drink tea. (to Knafeh)
answers.rationale: This starts with a family visit, not the requested tea and meal.

evaluation.correctExplanation: Tea precedes the meal, as requested.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.

steps.instruction: You understand the activity order, but still need a clock time. Ask for it.

prompt.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
prompt.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
prompt.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.

answers.rationale: This gives a time rather than asking.
This asks for the missing clock time.

answers.meaning: And afterwards we’ll make rice and salad.
answers.rationale: This repeats the sequence without asking for a time.

evaluation.correctExplanation: This asks for the missing clock time.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.

steps.instruction: Give the start of this arrangement: tomorrow at six, drink tea together.

answers.arabic: آه، بكرا الساعة سبعة نشرب شاي سوا.
answers.arabizi: Āh, bukra is-sāʿa sabʿa nishrab shāy sawa.
answers.meaning: Yes, tomorrow at seven we’ll drink tea together.
answers.rationale: The activity is right but seven is not six.

answers.arabic: اليوم الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
answers.arabizi: Il-yōm is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
answers.meaning: Today at six we’ll drink tea together.
answers.rationale: This changes the agreed day to today.

answers.arabic: بكرا الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
answers.arabizi: Bukra is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
answers.meaning: Tomorrow at six we’ll drink tea together.
answers.rationale: This names the starting activity, day and time.

evaluation.correctExplanation: This names the starting activity, day and time.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.

steps.instruction: Tea at six is now agreed. Add the meal as the next activity.

prompt.arabic: بكرا الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
prompt.arabizi: Bukra is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
prompt.meaning: Tomorrow at six we’ll drink tea together.

answers.meaning: And afterwards we’ll make rice and salad.
answers.rationale: This adds the meal after tea.

answers.meaning: And afterwards we’ll drink tea together.
answers.rationale: This repeats tea as the next activity instead of adding the meal.

answers.meaning: Shall we visit my family after work?
answers.rationale: This introduces a visit instead of the meal.

evaluation.correctExplanation: This adds the meal after tea.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.

steps.instruction: New plan: Knafeh suggests the meal. As Fattoush, confirm making rice and salad FIRST, then drinking tea.

prompt.meaning: Shall we make rice and salad?

answers.meaning: And afterwards we’ll drink tea together.
answers.rationale: This adds tea but does not explicitly confirm both activities as requested.

answers.arabic: نعمل رز وسلطة وبعدين نشرب شاي.
answers.arabizi: Niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa w-baʿdēn nishrab shāy.
answers.meaning: We’ll make rice and salad and then drink tea.
answers.rationale: This confirms the meal first and tea afterwards.

answers.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
answers.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
answers.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.
answers.rationale: This reverses the newly requested order.

evaluation.correctExplanation: This confirms the meal first and tea afterwards.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.
evaluation.retryHint: State both activities in the new order.

steps.instruction: Transfer: Knafeh suggests visiting his family after work. Confirm visiting HIS family, then drinking tea.

prompt.meaning: Shall we visit my family after work?

answers.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then visit your family. (to Knafeh)
answers.rationale: This reverses the visit and tea.

answers.meaning: Tomorrow at seven we’ll visit my family.
answers.rationale: Ahli would refer to your own family; it also invents a time.

answers.meaning: We’ll visit your family and then drink tea. (to Knafeh)
answers.rationale: Ahlak refers to Knafeh’s family, and tea comes afterwards.

evaluation.correctExplanation: Ahlak refers to Knafeh’s family, and tea comes afterwards.
evaluation.incorrectExplanation: This expression changes or omits a detail requested in this exchange.
evaluation.retryHint: Whose family, and what comes next?

introduction.goal: Link two shared activities in order, and ask for a clock time when “afterwards” is not precise enough.

line.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
line.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
line.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.

line.arabic: بكرا الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
line.arabizi: Bukra is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
line.meaning: Tomorrow at six we’ll drink tea together.
And afterwards we’ll make rice and salad.
Yes, let’s make rice and salad.

expressions.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
expressions.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
expressions.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.

expressions.arabic: بكرا الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
expressions.arabizi: Bukra is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
expressions.meaning: Tomorrow at six we’ll drink tea together.
And afterwards we’ll make rice and salad.

introduction.usageNote: Baʿdēn tells what follows; ayy sāʿa asks for a clock time. An activity sequence and an exact schedule answer different questions.
introduction.dialectNote: Urban Palestinian teaching target; transliteration remains available. Urban coffee pronunciation and address forms follow the first-unit model. Ahlak addresses Knafeh; ahli refers to the speaker’s own family. The scenes share an evening setting; these phrases do not teach how to distinguish morning from evening. No Jordanian variants or native-expert review claimed. ā/ī/ū and ē/ō mark long vowels; ʿ = ع, ḥ = ح, ʾ = glottal stop.
introduction.recordingNote: No reviewed recordings. Dialogue and prompt text are draft recording scripts. Speaker roles are explicit; do not label browser speech as reviewed Palestinian audio. All audio URLs remain null.

teachingCards.title: Tea first, meal second

phrase.arabic: نشرب شاي وبعدين نعمل رز وسلطة.
phrase.arabizi: Nishrab shāy w-baʿdēn niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa.
phrase.meaning: We’ll drink tea and then make rice and salad.

teachingCards.note: The activity before w-baʿdēn happens first. Here that is tea.
teachingCards.recallCue: Propose tea, then making rice and salad.

teachingCards.title: Reverse the order deliberately

phrase.arabic: نعمل رز وسلطة وبعدين نشرب شاي.
phrase.arabizi: Niʿmal ruzz w-salaṭa w-baʿdēn nishrab shāy.
phrase.meaning: We’ll make rice and salad and then drink tea.

teachingCards.note: Use the same two activities with a new order: meal before tea.
teachingCards.recallCue: The plan changes: make the meal first, then drink tea.

teachingCards.title: Ask for clock time
teachingCards.note: A sequence alone does not say when to start. Ayy sāʿa asks for that detail.
teachingCards.recallCue: Tea comes first, but when? Ask for the time.

teachingCards.title: Give the first activity a time

phrase.arabic: بكرا الساعة ستة نشرب شاي سوا.
phrase.arabizi: Bukra is-sāʿa sitte nishrab shāy sawa.
phrase.meaning: Tomorrow at six we’ll drink tea together.

teachingCards.note: This puts tea at six tomorrow. It does not set an exact time for the later meal.
teachingCards.recallCue: Confirm tea together tomorrow at six.

teachingCards.title: Keep the second activity connected

phrase.meaning: And afterwards we’ll make rice and salad.

teachingCards.note: After tea is established, w-baʿdēn connects the meal to it.
teachingCards.recallCue: Tea is agreed. Add making rice and salad afterwards.
